To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of metro for work and for leisure are predicted by different factors and the use of the future public transport system in Qatar is predicted by the factors of the theory of planned behaviour.

the intention to use a public transportation system can be predicted based on the theory of planned behaviour, and the factors that predict the intention to use differ according to the trip purpose (work versus leisure).
the intention to use public transportation is predicted by attitudes, perceived norms and perceived behavioral control.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of public transportation in Qatar.
the use of public transport in Qatar, and the factors that influence this use.
understanding the factors affecting the use of public transportation and how to improve its use.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intention to use an upcoming public transportation system can be predicted using a theory of planned behavior model.
the theory of planned behaviour is a useful model for predicting the intention of people in Qatar to use the metro.
perceived behavioral control and subjective norms are the main predictors of the intention to use public transportation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of a public transportation system depends on the perceived behavioral control and the subjective norms, and these two factors vary according to the purpose for which the metro system would be used.
the theory of planned behaviour is a useful tool in predicting the intention of residents of Qatar in using the metro for work and leisure.
the theory of planned behaviors can be applied to the use of a public transportation system in Qatar.
The main takeaway from our work is that
public transportation systems can be used as a tool for social inclusion, and not just as a means of transportation.

it is important to understand the factors influencing the intention to use public transportation in order to plan, design, and implement a public transport system that will be widely used by residents.
public transportation systems are not only about the provision of infrastructure, but also about changing the behavior of people and their attitudes toward public transportation.
